Clouded? No, not at all. My mind feels perfectly clear. I mean, I have to be sharp for my research. Withdrawn? No, I wouldn't say that. I still show up for all my teaching sections, and I'm keeping up with my data analysis for the department. I still ride my bike everywhere, too.

Controlling my thoughts? No, definitely not. My thoughts are completely my own. Nobody is literally putting thoughts in my head or making me do things. 

Though, I suppose if you want to get philosophical about it, the algorithms on the internet are basically trying to do that to everyone these days, right?
